categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of display driver chips. Its product portfolio includes integrated display chips such as TFT-LCD DDIC/TDDI, AMOLED display driver chips, touch chips, and MicroLED chips, as well as discrete display chips including display driver chips, power management chips, and timing control chips. These products serve various end markets including smart wearables, smartphones, industrial control displays, tablets, laptops, TVs, and automotive displays.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company operates under a fabless model, focusing on chip design and outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries. It has developed 19 core proprietary technologies covering image compression, low power charge recovery, reduced photomask layers, built-in capacitor technology, image enhancement, and advanced AMOLED driving techniques. The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, with a structured 'pre-research, development, and mass production' pipeline to maintain technological leadership and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading panel manufacturers such as BOE Technology, Tianma Microelectronics, Visionox, and other well-known display module companies like Yihua Display and Zhongxian Intelligent. The company serves diverse markets including consumer electronics (smartphones, wearables), industrial control, automotive displays, IT devices (tablets, laptops), TVs, and commercial displays. Its products support mainstream display technologies like TFT-LCD and AMOLED across various panel sizes and resolutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shanghai, China, with subsidiaries and operations in Beijing, Xi'an, Hefei, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. Its primary market is mainland China, which accounts for the majority of its revenue, with additional sales in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Macau. The company collaborates with global foundries including TSMC and SMIC for manufacturing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics operates primarily as a fabless semiconductor design company, positioned midstream in the supply chain. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and downstream assembly partners. The company maintains strong supply chain collaboration with wafer foundries and packaging/testing vendors to optimize cost and production efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation in display driver chips, emphasizing low power consumption, high resolution, high refresh rates, and integration capabilities. It is expanding product lines to include emerging technologies such as Mini/Micro-LED and AR/AI glasses displays. Strategic R&D investments focus on enhancing AMOLED and TFT-LCD chip performance, developing new products for automotive and commercial displays, and accelerating new product industrialization. The company also plans to grow through strategic acquisitions to complement its technology and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of integrated circuit products, specifically display driver chips and related semiconductor components. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, selling mainly to panel manufacturers and module assemblers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products. The company also earns income from technology development services and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai New Vision Microelectronics is one of the leading domestic display driver chip suppliers in China, competing with other integrated circuit design firms serving the display industry. It holds a strong position due to its comprehensive product portfolio, proprietary technologies, and close collaboration with major panel manufacturers. The company faces competition in a challenging market with pricing pressures, especially in consumer electronics segments, but maintains competitive advantages through innovation and supply chain integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 507.4 million, representing a 5.61% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.43 million, a decline of 69.38% compared to the previous year, mainly due to pricing pressures and reduced gross margins. R&D expenses accounted for 12.98% of revenue, reflecting increased investment in innovation. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.79 billion and net assets of RMB 1.57 billion as of year-end 2024, with a stable but cautious growth trajectory amid industry competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies that enable low power consumption, small chip area, high reliability, strong electrostatic discharge resistance, and support for high resolution and refresh rates. Its integrated and discrete display chips cover a wide range of applications and panel sizes, providing customers with comprehensive and cost-effective display solutions. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, close customer collaboration, and supply chain integration enable rapid product iteration and customization, differentiating it in the competitive display semiconductor market.
